callback_boundary.stage4: FromRoot: shared apply performs AnyValue::as_any and the Any downcast, then calls reference<Target>(&Ref<FerroObject>), whose body casts the class and boxes the weak result.
callback_boundary.trial: Borrowed(Static): shared apply performs AnyValue::as_any and invokes the concrete fn(&dyn Any). That leaf performs the Any downcast and class cast directly before boxing. It never calls the separate metadata reference helper.
callback_boundary.metadata_callback: The original 122-byte metadata reference helper remains in the descriptor at offset 8; the two new static root callbacks occupy offsets 16 and 24 in the 80-byte native descriptor.
callback_boundary.ownership: The trial uses plain static function pointers and no Rc callback adapter. It does not introduce an owning root-handle clone before the class check. Failure exits before result boxing.
callback_boundary.size_observation: The two selected Target callback bodies are 169 bytes each; the shared apply body is 303 bytes. These are exact diagnostic native function sizes, not a predicted whole-application size delta.
